title: FTFN v0.3 — The public knowledge edition
summary: An evidence-linked editorial layer that turns the existing signal, source, briefing, project, measurement and stewardship corpus into canonical reviews, narrative casebooks, cross-system stories, outcome observatories, uncertainty pages, learning modules, accessible editions and a living publication.
publication_boundaries: Every public page resolves existing evidence and preserves the status of its upstream records.
No page creates a future receipt, advances a Phase 60 or Phase 61 gate, or converts a missing observation into an outcome.
Cross-system stories are editorial reading frames, not causal findings, forecasts, recommendations, scores or rankings.
French and Spanish translation briefs remain In Review until a qualified human reviewer signs off; no machine output is represented as reviewed translation.

phases.title: Canonical review
phases.content_goal: Synthesize the existing evidence shelf into 17 topic chapters, five place portraits, a public method and a common review hub.

phases.title: Narrative casebooks
phases.content_goal: Turn eight named project and adoption files into source-linked histories from authorization to operation.

phases.title: Cross-system atlas
phases.content_goal: Publish twelve evidence-bounded stories that make dependencies visible across topics and places.

phases.title: Outcomes observatory
phases.content_goal: Expose the eight measurement contracts, denominators and evidence gaps without manufacturing outcome claims.

phases.title: Uncertainty library
phases.content_goal: Give every topic a structured counterargument, competing-explanation and decisive-evidence reading page.

phases.title: Civic learning edition
phases.content_goal: Create seventeen topic modules with beginner, practitioner and expert reading paths.

phases.title: Accessible editions
phases.content_goal: Publish seventeen plain-language topic editions and five low-bandwidth place notes; hold translations for human review.

phases.title: Living publication
phases.content_goal: Establish the state report, correction log, freshness board, editorial calendar and eight evidence journeys.
